observation_window.boundary_note: Every FY2019 flow and event is after the 2018-09-30 cutoff. Product-arena, issuer, industry-context and ordinary-share-cash boundaries remain typed separately.

industry_epoch.condition: Domestic white goods were entering slower category growth and stronger concentration, while portfolio companies combined product upgrades, channel work and other businesses.
industry_epoch.observed_concentration: Category leaders were disclosed, but no same-boundary concentration series was frozen.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Product, channel, price and installation capacity convert seasonal demand into air-conditioner sales and margin.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Product mix, sell-through, channel efficiency and unit margin.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: A hot season or low price can lift revenue without durable execution quality.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Product freshness, efficiency, brand and channel economics shape replacement demand and margin.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Volume, price-mix, brand investment, unit cost and working capital.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: Mix or acquisition can move reported revenue without organic customer preference.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Television, IT, intermediate products and portfolio actions alter consolidated revenue, margin and cash independently of white goods.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Business mix, perimeter, non-operating gains and capital allocation.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: Group improvement can be mistaken for white-goods operating quality.

members.cutoff_state: FY2017 air-conditioner and refrigerator revenue grew rapidly while product gross margin fell; group operating cash declined and the issuer retained television, IT, intermediate products and portfolio effects.
members.decision_heterogeneity: Management combined product launches, channel adjustment and organization reform inside a broader multi-business group, making boundary discipline the primary question.

strongest_common_rivals: Television, IT and intermediate-product performance can dominate consolidated movement.
Category cycle and product mix can lift white-goods revenue without better customer preference.
Portfolio disposals or acquisitions can alter group profit and cash without operating improvement.
unresolved_questions: Did white-goods revenue and gross margin move coherently after the cutoff?
Did disclosed product and channel work translate into execution rather than deployment?
Did consolidated cash fund required capital, and was any residual accessible to ordinary shares?
Did portfolio scope or leverage change the permanent-loss path?

question_set.question: What initial portfolio boundary and rival explanations govern the white-goods question?
Did implemented product and channel work translate into coherent white-goods execution?
Did product-arena absorption and gross margin support customer and unit-economic progress?
Could issuer funding and leverage support the business without assuming ordinary-share owner cash?

claims.statement: The listed issuer entered the cutoff as a television, white-goods, IT, intermediate-product and other-business portfolio; white goods competed in category-specific arenas rather than as a homogeneous group business.
FY2017 evidence records product launches, product-mix work, channel adjustment and organization changes, but implementation is not evidence of customer acceptance or economic effect.
White-goods execution requires post-cutoff product-arena revenue and gross-margin coherence; consolidated issuer growth cannot substitute for those observations.
Air-conditioner and refrigerator revenue can show product-arena absorption, but without volume, price and share separation it cannot establish preference or competitive advantage.
The air-conditioner and refrigerator gross margin is the product-arena economic observation; television, IT and intermediate-product margin cannot replace it.
Consolidated operating cash and cash capex describe issuer funding only; ordinary-share owner cash requires a separate bridge through required capital and priority claims.
Leverage, portfolio changes and owner-cash access must be reviewed separately before concluding that product growth reduced permanent-loss risk.
Category cycle, product mix, television/IT/intermediate-product performance and portfolio changes can reproduce consolidated improvement without better white-goods execution.

hypotheses.statement: Product and channel actions improve product-arena absorption and gross margin coherently.
Category cycle, price or mix changes revenue without better unit economics.
Product-arena absorption reflects stronger customer response.
Volume, price, mix and category cycle remain unresolved drivers.
Issuer cash covers capital needs without weakening ordinary-share resilience.
Leverage, portfolio scope and inaccessible subsidiary cash leave permanent-loss risk unresolved.

output_rule.WHITE_GOODS_POSITIVE: product revenue and margin are positive, group/product guard passes, and backdrop is not negative
output_rule.WHITE_GOODS_NEGATIVE: product revenue and margin are negative and group/product guard passes
output_rule.WHITE_GOODS_UNKNOWN: fully observed signals do not meet a directional rule or group/product directions diverge
output_rule.NOT_DIAGNOSTIC: one or more signals UNKNOWN or MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH

baseline.primary_question_projection: Answer only a simple white-goods operating trend; never promote a group trend across the product boundary.
baseline.prohibited_post_outcome_revision: No customer, action-causality, owner-cash, portfolio or new threshold condition may be added after freeze.

dimension_rules.resolution_rule: Observed only for an explicit FY2019 implemented product/channel/organization action; effect remains unproved.

SUPPORTED_TREND only when action is OBSERVED_YES and both product revenue and margin are OBSERVED_INCREASE; WEAKENED_TREND when both product signals decrease; MIXED otherwise; any unavailable input is NOT_DIAGNOSTIC.
Revenue and portfolio share are descriptive absorption only; without frozen volume, price or customer-share cells the conclusion is always NOT_DIAGNOSTIC for customer preference.
Use the product-arena gross-margin label only; do not attribute cause.
Issuer funding may be described from OCF and coverage; owner cash is supported only by OBSERVED_YES owner-cash bridge.
Adverse leverage or scope change is a risk signal; absence is not proof against permanent loss and owner-cash UNKNOWN remains local.
Portfolio rival is material when group and product directions diverge, product share decreases, or a scope event is observed.

enhanced.ordinary_share_rule: No group OCF, capex or dividend may substitute for the contracted owner-cash bridge.
enhanced.prohibited_post_outcome_revision: No threshold, dimension rule, rival or boundary may be added after freeze.

paired_utility_rules.NO_DIFFERENCE: Both methods reach the same decision-relevant treatment from frozen rules.
paired_utility_rules.NOT_DIAGNOSTIC: A required field is unavailable or neither method-specific material condition is met.
